4_rules.name: Subject case
4_rules.message: Subject is in the nominative (prathama vibhakti).

4_rules.name: Object case
4_rules.message: Object (if any) is in the accusative (dvitiya vibhakti).

4_rules.name: Subject-verb number agreement
4_rules.message: Subject and verb agree in number (singular).

4_rules.name: Subject-verb person agreement
4_rules.message: Subject and verb agree in person (3rd person).

4_rules.name: Adjective-noun agreement
4_rules.message: Every adjective agrees with its noun in gender, case, and number.

4_rules.name: No duplicate roles
4_rules.message: No word fills two roles at once.

4_rules.name: Known words only
4_rules.message: Every word was found in the vocabulary.
